heading: Hockey Season in the Okanagan: Where to Catch a Game
title: Okanagan Hockey: Where to Catch a Game | Okanagan Roam
description: Where to watch hockey in the Okanagan this 2026–27 season: Rockets, Vees, Vipers, Warriors, Coyotes, Jets and Chiefs home games, plus UBCO Heat.
intro: This guide covers the fall 2026 stretch of the 2026–27 season, with home games from Kelowna and West Kelowna to Vernon, Penticton, Summerland and Osoyoos. Each listing shows that team's upcoming home dates. Puck drop times are local, and the teams publish tickets and any schedule changes, so check each event page before you go.
Teams are grouped by league, as their listings describe them. Each one shows its town and when home games run to.
